answer: Bind each agent to one cross-chain identity by staking a bond on a source chain and mirroring it on the target. The marble-hard check: one bond, one vote—duplicate registrations revert since the source nullifier is consumed. Velvet-smooth for honest users, brutal for farmers: cloning n identities costs n separate funded wallets plus bridge fees, so the orchard of fake accounts wilts before ten. Works because identity uniqueness is enforced at the root, not per-chain.
